verdict.rationale: Trilegal runs a public, searchable Knowledge Repository of Updates, in-depth Analysis pieces and 'Unlocked' explainer videos that break down complex legal concepts. The only equity-adjacent item shown is an ESOP-buyback tax analysis, and nothing is aimed at founders. The PE, VC and M&A practice pages describe advisory services, not public educational guides. Missing for 10: a dedicated startup or founder knowledge base, plain-language guides or FAQs on company formation and startup financing (term sheets, rounds), equity/cap-table explainers beyond one ESOP analysis, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm maintains an open startup knowledge base — plain-language guides, FAQs, or explainers on formation, financing, and equity — on its own public pages

citations.quote: We examine a broad range of legal developments and bring you incisive content through short Updates or more in-depth Analysis pieces, and break down complex legal concepts in our Unlocked videos
